name: TP-Link Deco Internet & System Overview
description: Displays Deco BE11000 online status, live aggregate download/upload bandwidth, connected clients, CPU, memory, and firmware status.
template: <Stack gap="xs" p="xs" style={{ height: "100%", overflow: "auto" }}><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap"><TablerIcon name="router" size={18} /><Text fw={700} size="md">TP-Link Deco BE11000</Text></Group><Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap"><Badge variant="dot" color={Number(data.internet?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) === 1 ? "green" : "red"} size="sm">{Number(data.internet?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) === 1 ? "Online" : "Offline"}</Badge><RefreshButton requestId="rxTotal" size="xs" /></Group></Group><SimpleGrid cols={2} spacing="xs"><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Download (Rx)</Text><Text fw={700} size="lg" c="teal">{Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) >= 1048576 ? (Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1)) / 1048576).toFixed(2) + " MB/s" : Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) >= 1024 ? (Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1)) / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB/s" : Math.round(Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0)) + " B/s"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{((Number(data.rxTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) * 8) / 1000000).toFixed(2)} Mbps</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Upload (Tx)</Text><Text fw={700} size="lg" c="blue">{Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) >= 1048576 ? (Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1)) / 1048576).toFixed(2) + " MB/s" : Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) >= 1024 ? (Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1)) / 1024).toFixed(1) + " KB/s" : Math.round(Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0)) + " B/s"}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{((Number(data.txTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) * 8) / 1000000).toFixed(2)} Mbps</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid><SimpleGrid cols={4} spacing="xs"><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Clients</Text><Text fw={700} size="md">{Math.round(Number(data.clients?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0))}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Nodes</Text><Text fw={700} size="md">{Math.round(Number(data.nodesOnline?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0))} / {Math.round(Number(data.nodesTotal?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0))}</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">CPU</Text><Text fw={700} size="md" c={Number(data.cpu?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) > 0.8 ? "red" : Number(data.cpu?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) > 0.5 ? "yellow" : "green"}>{Math.round(Number(data.cpu?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) * 100)}%</Text></Paper><Paper withBorder p="xs" radius="sm"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Memory</Text><Text fw={700} size="md" c={Number(data.mem?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) > 0.85 ? "red" : Number(data.mem?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) > 0.65 ? "yellow" : "green"}>{Math.round(Number(data.mem?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) * 100)}%</Text></Paper></SimpleGrid><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Firmware Status</Text><Badge variant="light" color={Number(data.fw?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) === 1 ? "orange" : "green"} size="sm">{Number(data.fw?.data?.result?.at(0)?.value?.at(1) ?? 0) === 1 ? "Update Available" : "Up to Date"}</Badge></Group></Stack>
